summary.text: Peter Varney is a Republican state representative from Belknap 7 who has served in the House since 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Varney is a business owner and has served as chief of the New Durham Fire Department.

paragraphs.text: Peter Varney's career experience includes owning ATS Applied Technical Services and working as an emergency management director.
He has served as chief of the New Durham Fire Department.
At the start of the 2015 legislative session, Varney served on the House Municipal and County Government Committee.
